a.lede: The FBI has confirmed that North Korean state-sponsored hackers known as TraderTraitor were behind the $6.3 billion crypto-theft attack on Binance, making it the largest cryptocurrency heist on record. [...]
a.title: FBI links $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers

b.lede: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, has linked the theft of about $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency to a DevOps engineer's compromised laptop. [...]
b.title: Binance links $6.3 billion crypto theft to compromised DevOps laptop
